header: A counter screen built from your own articles
lead: If a till needs training, staff work around it on a busy Saturday.
bodytext:
The counter view is built from your article list, not from a menu. Rolls, coffee and wholemeal bread stay where you put them. The only other buttons are the four the law requires: cash, card, cancel and receipt.

New staff usually serve on their own after one shift. We know this from watching, not from a survey.
caption: The counter view on the tablet at Café Hollergrund in Linz.
note: The demo is a live 30-minute session, not a recording. It's run by someone who installs tills in bakeries.

image.alternative: A baker carries a tray of pastries while a colleague uses the tablet till at the counter.
